title: coleus sanguineus
intro: Coleus sanguineus, commonly known as Flame Nettle or Red Coleus, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, belonging to the family Lamiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The plant's therapeutic actions include its analgesic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate pain, fight infections, and soothe irritated skin. The bioactive constituents of Coleus sanguineus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
